standard-dialogue-after-royal-trouble-wh.npc: I hear you made peace between our kingdom and Etceteria once more. Well done, [Fremennik name].
I hear you made peace between our kingdom and Etceteria once more. Well done, dear friend.

options.text: Princess Astrid, will you marry me?

steps.player: Princess Astrid, will you marry me?

steps.npc: Oh, my darling, you've made me the happiest person alive.
Yes! We'll have to put off the actual ceremony until we can find a priest, but I will tell my father I have agreed to marry you.

standard-dialogue-after-royal-trouble-wh.npc: I hear you made peace between our kingdom and Etceteria once more. Well done, darling.

options.text: Have you found a priest for our marriage yet?

steps.player: Have you found a priest for our marriage yet?

steps.npc: I'm afraid not, darling. I don't think there is one to be had on these islands for love nor money...
Do not fear, though; I shall call for you as soon as one is found.

options.text: I'm having second thoughts about the wedding.

steps.player: I'm having second thoughts about the wedding. This marriage would change things, with an increase in responsibilities and duties that would overshadow the activities you like.
While I want to support you and the kingdom, I don't want that to end up impacting your life negatively. Maybe it's too soon to make this kind of decision.

steps.npc: My darling, that is very thoughtful of you and you make a convincing point. Are you... absolutely sure?

options.text: Yes, I think it's for the best.

steps.player: Yes, I think it's for the best.

steps.npc: I think you'll make a great Thane for our kingdom.

steps.player: Maybe not. It it hard, for I am so very fond of you. Let's leave it as it is for now and see what the future holds.

using-flowers-on-princess-astrid-after-r.npc: You've already given me some, but thank you.

using-a-bow-on-princess-astrid-after-roy.npc: You've already given me one, but thank you.
